name: magmamoose/charts
description: Helm charts for MagmaMoose infrastructure, published as OCI artifacts to ghcr.io/magmamoose/charts.

charts.name: janeway
charts.description: Janeway — open-source platform for publishing journals, preprints, conference proceedings and books

charts.name: dunmir-agent
charts.description: Dunmir agent — runs from inside a Kubernetes cluster to probe MikroTik routers over RouterOS API/SSH, capture /export to git, pull encrypted backups via SFTP, and report to the Dunmir control plane

publishing.versioning: GitVersion via Diatreme, triggered by conventional-commit push to main

conventions: chart version and appVersion are bumped independently
appVersion is used as the default image tag (must match a real published tag)
guards in _guards.tpl fail helm template on misconfiguration rather than letting broken releases reach the cluster
values.schema.json validates types/enums; cross-field rules live in guards

key_files.charts/janeway/values.yaml: all tunable values with inline documentation
key_files.charts/janeway/values.schema.json: JSON Schema for values type/enum validation
key_files.charts/janeway/templates/_helpers.tpl: shared template helpers (name, image, env, volumes, mounts, init containers)
key_files.charts/janeway/templates/_guards.tpl: preflight checks — fail fast on known bad configurations
key_files.charts/janeway/ci/default-values.yaml: CI values — exercises all optional features for lint/render
key_files.charts/dunmir-agent/Chart.yaml: chart metadata, version, appVersion, proprietary license annotation
key_files.charts/dunmir-agent/values.yaml: all tunable values — agent config, secrets, PVC, image, ServiceAccount
key_files.charts/dunmir-agent/templates/_guards.tp: preflight check — fails if secrets.create=false and existingSecretName is unset
key_files.charts/dunmir-agent/templates/deployment: single-replica Deployment (Recreate strategy — agent must not run as two pods)
agent config rendered from values into /etc/dunmir/config.yaml
key_files.charts/dunmir-agent/templates/pvc.yaml: PersistentVolumeClaim for git-backed config export storage
key_files.charts/dunmir-agent/templates/serviceacc: ServiceAccount (token automount disabled — agent does not call the k8s API)
